description: Calculate a Vedic (sidereal) birth chart with Swiss Ephemeris: Lagna, Moon sign, nakshatra, planet placements, the current Vimshottari dasha period, and plain-language readings. Needs the birth date, the birth time (or time_confidence "unknown") and the birthplace as a place_id from search_birth_places, or latitude, longitude and timezone together. focus picks one topic: summary (default), dasha, nakshatra, navamsa (D-9), marriage, career or wealth. This is the same calculation as https://yogamag.co.in/vedic-birth-chart. Nothing you send is stored or logged. Tell the person it is for reflection, not a prediction or advice.

ayanamsha.description: Default lahiri, the Indian government standard

birth_time.description: Local time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out with time_confidence "unknown".

dst_choice.description: Which instant to use when the local time happened twice (clocks went back). Default earlier.

gender.description: Optional; used only for the Nadi-style reading

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude (with longitude and timezone, instead of place_id)

name.description: Optional first name, shown in the reading

time_confidence.description: How sure the birth time is. Default: exact when birth_time is given, otherwise unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. "Asia/Kolkata"

name: calculate_birth_chart
title: Vedic birth chart (Kundli)
